contract: Road user a turns to the right from an observed onset: over one continuous stretch in which it moves and its heading turns to the right, its heading changes to the right by at least the turn angle, the heading change below which turning counts as no change of course. Measured as drv.motion.turning_right (with the yaw tolerance and the speed tolerance) holding at every observation since the observation at which it last became true, and the heading change since that observation (integrated from kin.yaw_rate, degrees, left positive, with the step bound, the largest interval between consecutive observations integrated across) at or below the negative of the turn angle. The act's observed beginning is the observation at which drv.motion.turning_right last became true. The act is recognized at the first observation of the stretch, its beginning included, at which the heading change since that beginning reaches the negative of the turn angle: where the heading change at the beginning, which is zero there, already reaches it, the beginning is the recognition observation, and a heading change measured at an observation before the beginning, from an earlier beginning, has no bearing on which observation is first. The concept holds at the recognition observation only. Conduct before the observed beginning is no part of the act, and where that beginning is not observed (the stretch began before the recording, or an unknown turning state could hide its start) whether the act occurred is unknown. A stretch that ends before its heading change reaches the negative of the turn angle is no turn; a road user that follows a bend of the way through that angle turns in this sense. Not a stand-in for the turn indicator or a declared intention to turn, nor for a lane change, whose heading change stays short of the turn angle.

params.name: turn_angle
params.meaning: the heading change below which turning counts as no change of course

params.name: yaw_tolerance
params.meaning: the yaw rate magnitude below which a change of heading counts as none

params.name: speed_tolerance
params.meaning: the speed at or below which the road user counts as at rest

params.name: step
params.meaning: the step bound of the heading integration

act.onset: The act's observed beginning is the observation at which drv.motion.turning_right last became true.
act.recognition: The act is recognized at the first observation of the stretch, its beginning included, at which the heading change since that beginning reaches the negative of the turn angle: where the heading change at the beginning, which is zero there, already reaches it, the beginning is the recognition observation, and a heading change measured at an observation before the beginning, from an earlier beginning, has no bearing on which observation is first.
act.extent: The concept holds at the recognition observation only.
act.history: Conduct before the observed beginning is no part of the act, and where that beginning is not observed (the stretch began before the recording, or an unknown turning state could hide its start) whether the act occurred is unknown.

elements.span: drv.motion.turning_right (with the yaw tolerance and the speed tolerance) holding at every observation since the observation at which it last became true
elements.justification: drv.motion.turning_right is the state 'it moves and its heading turns to the right' at each observation; its last rise is the onset and its holding since is the continuous stretch.

elements.span: the heading change since that observation (integrated from kin.yaw_rate, degrees, left positive, with the step bound
elements.justification: kin.yaw_rate, 'positive when the heading turns to the left', integrated since the onset (Term.headingSince with the step bound, 'counted from zero at that observation'): a right turn is a negative heading change; 'Not a stand-in for: road curvature' is stated in the contract.

elements.span: The act is recognized at the first observation of the stretch, its beginning included, at which the heading change since that beginning reaches the negative of the turn angle
elements.justification: 'First' is judged over the stretch alone: the comparison holds here and at no earlier observation since the rise of drv.motion.turning_right, the rise itself included. Term.headingSince is 'counted from zero at that observation', so at the rise the comparison is decided by the zero change alone; the observation before a rise lies outside the stretch, and a comparison there is measured from an earlier onset ('only the next definite rise of ψ starts it again'), so a comparison that held there does not make the rise a later reaching. The recognition is therefore the rise of drv.motion.turning_right where the comparison already holds there, and otherwise an observation after the rise at which the comparison holds and held at no earlier observation since the rise.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: a, moving, starts yawing right at a junction and keeps yawing until its heading has turned a quarter turn to the right; the concept holds where the change first reaches the negative of the turn angle.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: a drifts right for a lane change; its yaw stops long before the heading change reaches the turn angle.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: a turns at a junction, but the source supplies no yaw rate.

differs_from.why: the opposite hand: a rightward stretch and a negative heading change
